# Argo CD Sync Failed

## Symptoms
- Application OutOfSync or SyncError

## Diagnosis
1. Argo CD UI / CLI: sync error message and diff.
2. CRD availability, namespace, and RBAC for apply.

## Remediation
- Fix manifest or cluster permissions; retry sync.

## Verification
- Application Synced and Healthy.

# GitOps Config Drift

## Symptoms
- Cluster state diverges from Git; sync failures

## Diagnosis
1. Compare live manifest vs Git revision.
2. Identify manual kubectl edits or failed sync.

## Remediation
- Reconcile from Git source of truth.
- Block manual edits via policy if recurring.

## Verification
- Sync healthy; drift detectors quiet.

# ErrImageNeverPull

## Symptoms
- Pod events ErrImageNeverPull — image not present locally with imagePullPolicy Never

## Diagnosis
- oc describe pod — confirm imagePullPolicy: Never
- Check if image exists on node: crictl/cursor debug node

## Remediation
- Pre-load image on node or change pull policy to IfNotPresent/Always
- Use correct tag available on node

## Verification
- Container starts without image pull errors

## Source
- https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/#image-pull-policy

# ErrImagePull

## Symptoms
- Immediate image pull failure before BackOff

## Diagnosis
1. Invalid registry hostname, auth, or malformed image reference.
2. Architecture mismatch (arm vs amd).

## Remediation
- Fix image name/tag; configure pull credentials.

## Verification
- Image pulls successfully; pod starts.

# Git Patch Rejected

## Symptoms
- Remediation git_patch fails CI or admission

## Diagnosis
1. Read PR/check logs — schema, policy, or test failure.

## Remediation
- Adjust patch to pass validation; split into smaller commits.

## Verification
- Patch merged; cluster sync shows new revision.

# Helm Hook Failed

## Symptoms
- Helm release stuck; pre/post upgrade hook pod failed

## Diagnosis
1. `helm history` and hook pod logs.
2. Check hook weights and delete policies.

## Remediation
- Fix hook Job manifest or resource dependencies.
- Retry release after correcting chart values.

## Verification
- `helm status` deployed; hook pods completed.

# ImagePullBackOff

## Symptoms
- ErrImagePull / ImagePullBackOff on pod

## Diagnosis
1. Verify image tag exists in registry (`crane manifest` or registry UI).
2. Check imagePullSecrets on ServiceAccount.
3. OpenShift: verify ImageStream tag and internal registry route.

## Remediation
- git_patch correct image repository/tag.
- Add or fix pull secret; wire to ServiceAccount.

## Verification
- Pod Running; no ErrImagePull events in 5m.

# InvalidImageName

## Symptoms
- Pod events: invalid reference format

## Diagnosis
1. Inspect image field for typos, illegal chars, missing tag.

## Remediation
- Correct image reference in Deployment/StatefulSet manifest.

## Verification
- Scheduler accepts manifest; pull proceeds.

# OpenShift ImageStream Import Failed

## Symptoms
- ImageStream tag import failed; deployment cannot resolve internal image
- Build/deploy references ImageStreamTag not imported

## Diagnosis
- oc describe imagestream/<name> -n <namespace>
- oc import-image or check external registry credentials

## Remediation
- Fix source registry pull secret on builder SA
- Re-import tag or point deployment to external image directly

## Verification
- ImageStreamTag shows imported metadata; pods pull successfully

## Source
- https://docs.redhat.com/en/documentation/openshift_container_platform/latest/html/building_applications/images

# ReplicaSet Selector Mismatch

## Symptoms
- Deployment creates new ReplicaSet but pods not selected
- selector immutable field error on patch

## Diagnosis
- oc get rs -n <namespace> — show-labels
- Compare deployment selector vs pod template labels

## Remediation
- Fix template metadata.labels to match spec.selector
- Recreate deployment if selector must change (requires migration)

## Verification
- ReplicaSet owns expected pods; rollout completes

## Source
- https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/deployment/

# Rollout Stuck

## Symptoms
- Deployment progress deadline exceeded; mixed old/new replicas

## Diagnosis
1. New ReplicaSet pod failures (image, probes, quota).
2. `oc rollout status deployment/<name>`.

## Remediation
- Fix failing new pods; rollback if bad release.
- OpenShift: check DeploymentConfig vs Deployment strategy.

## Verification
- All updated replicas Ready; rollout complete.
